description: Photo collage assembled around the 'red shoes' conspiracy theme. Panels include: Bill Maher on a street wearing bright red shoes with a close-up crop of the shoes; a MAGA lion logo in red/white/blue; a group photo of about a dozen men in suits, several wearing matching red shoes; a Wikipedia summary box on the disappearance of Madeleine McCann; a photo of Bill Maher posing with Anthony Weiner; and a smiling portrait of a man consistent with Tony Podesta. The juxtaposition implies a connection between red shoes, these figures, and the McCann case without stating one.
text: MAGA. Disappearance of Madeleine McCann. Madeleine Beth McCann disappeared on the evening of 3 May 2007 from her bed in a holiday apartment in Praia da Luz, a resort in the Algarve region of Portugal, sparking what one newspaper called "the most heavily reported missing-person case in modern history". Her whereabouts remain unknown. More at Wikipedia.
flags: Collage implies an unsubstantiated conspiratorial link between the pictured men, red shoes, and the McCann disappearance; no such connection is established
Tony Podesta identification from likeness, probable but not caption-confirmed
Men in the group photo other than those named are unidentified private individuals

description: Street-level photograph taken through a vehicle windshield of a dense commercial street in Hong Kong, lined with high-rise buildings and overhanging bilingual shop signs. A green-bordered sign for 'Western Pacific Kindergarten' hangs over the street, with an enlarged inset crop of that sign pasted at the top of the image, marking it as the point of interest. Cars are parked along both sides and pedestrians cross the road; other signs advertise a noodle/congee shop and a sauna.

description: Screenshot of a news headline credited to Reuters reporting that four planes made emergency landings in Chile, Peru and Argentina due to bomb threats, attributed to the Chilean civil aviation authority. description: Annotated screenshot of an email published in the WikiLeaks Podesta Emails archive (emailid 50428), subject 'Re: Upcoming Events', dated 2015-05-30, sent from AKauders@podestagroup.com to podesta@podesta.com. Red boxes highlight the sender address and the event line 'An Evening of Cooking with John Podesta'; a yellow highlight labels the sender as 'Andrew Kauders'; red underlines mark 'John Podesta and Robby Mook' and 'Marguerite Thompson'. The email announces Mid-Atlantic finance events including a cooking evening with chef Nora Pouillon.
text: Re: Upcoming Events. From:AKauders@podestagroup.com. Andrew Kauders. To: podesta@podesta.com. CC: hkliegman@podestagroup.com, john.podesta@gmail.com. Date: 2015-05-30 19:01. Subject: Re: Upcoming Events. Dear Friend,. We are pleased to share the upcoming Mid-Atlantic finance events with John Podesta and Robby Mook:. An Evening of Cooking with John Podesta. and Special Guest Chef Nora Pouillon. Friday, June 5, 2015 | 6:30 pm - 8:30 pm. Home of Marguerite Thompson. https://wikileaks.org/podesta-emails/emailid/50428
flags: Annotations (boxes, highlight, underlines) were added by the person who made the screenshot, not part of the original email
Marguerite Thompson is a private individual named in the email

description: Screenshot of Q drop #1721 (board No.2310523, Jul 27 2018), which quotes Q's earlier post No.2310449. The quoted post attaches a nighttime photo overlooking a Thames-side street in London with the London Eye lit blue, traffic queued along the embankment, and a yellow circle drawn around two pedestrians; its caption reads 'When does a bird sing?'. Drop 1721 adds a second image: a blurred close-up crop of the circled couple with a white arrow, placed next to a Daily Mail-credited photograph of a dark-haired woman consistent with Lisa Page. The composition implies the circled couple is Lisa Page with a companion in London, which is not verifiable from the image.
